title: Man-made craft rising from desert openings
summary: Steven Greer tells of Man-made craft rising from desert openings, about an unknown time at Desert, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, you know, I've been over sites where that these objects that are man-made come up out of the desert
I've been to that site. I have videotape and photographs from my iPhone flying in a chopper over the Lockheed Skunk Works site where the man-made stuff comes up.
tellings.difference: Names the site as Lockheed Skunk Works, says he flew over it by helicopter and filmed it on an iPhone, and dates it to 2023.
tellings.link_reason: Greer's account of flying over a desert site where man-made craft come up out of the ground, the same claim as the man-made-craft story.

as_told.title: Greer helicopter flyover of Lockheed Skunk Works site
